pollination_subset: source-coded animal only; unresolved syndrome excluded
reading: Archipelago-specific slopes and mean log response ratios are a descriptive heterogeneity audit. They test whether one global island-rule coefficient hides different regional response shapes; they do not make island groups independent experimental treatments or identify pollinator dependency.
claim_boundary: Flower morphology and source-coded pollination syndrome are not effective-dependency measures. Small archipelago subsets are not used for causal geological-origin claims, and these rows are not entered as independent effects in the cross-system registry.
